prompt:
Write 6 short claim log entries (one to three sentences each) by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim, in time order. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1426; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- Nothing suggests the damage happened before the coverage started.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for a parking lot collision with the insured's vehicle and a second vehicle. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's office.

Entry 2: Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the accident happened as described, and the other driver's account matches. Scene photos were received and reviewed.

Entry 3: Vehicle damage is mostly in line with the described impact. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing suggests the damage predates the start of coverage. The driver is confirmed as named on the policy.

Entry 4: The claimant's reported knee injury matches the kind and force of this crash well. No prior injury to the same area is known from records reviewed so far.

Entry 5: Treatment has run somewhat longer than usual for this type of injury. The claimant has told the same account in every conversation with the adjuster, and the police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time.

Entry 6: Medical records and treatment timeline are being requested through counsel. Reserves are under review pending receipt of the records.
